_comment: Portable, account-neutral baseline for a production-like deployment. It is useful for simple
standalone deployments, but it is not authoritative configuration for any particular operator.
When no external parameter file is supplied, provision.sh and deploy.sh pass this file to every
az deployment so a redeploy cannot silently reapply a Bicep default.
An operator can supply an authoritative ARM parameter file as argument 4 to either script. That
file replaces this baseline and should explicitly set the complete persistent parameter surface.
Deliberately absent because they are release-specific and supplied on the command line:
Deliberately absent because they are secrets held in Key Vault:
the connector API key, the eBay client id and client secret, and the eBay marketplace
Do not commit account-specific values such as alert recipients here. Keep them in an external
operator-owned parameter file or a gitignored prod.local.parameters.json overlay.
